dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible, characterized by thin, high-contrast light perimeters against a dark base. The transition from the dark exterior to the light perimeter is sharp, while the interior of the structures often shows a softer gradient back to the darker base color.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, high-intensity light-colored pixel clusters lacking internal gradients is observed, particularly concentrated in the lower central and right-lateral regions of the visible skin area.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli in the upper right quadrant form an obtuse scalene triangle. A series of smaller high-intensity blobs below these form an irregular, nearly linear chain extending toward the bottom edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct linear reddish-brown mark is visible in the upper-mid dorsal section, oriented diagonally, which does not conform to the surrounding ring-based pigmentation and indicates a superficial scar or temporal mark.
other_distinctive_markers: A notable transition in texture density is present, where the complex macro-annuli patterns in the upper half of the frame give way to simpler, isolated blob-like features in the lower half.
